review_description: I had some concerns regarding ownership, and I was pleasantly surprised by the exceptional customer service I received. I got a call from Abhy, who addressed my concerns promptly and professionally. He took the time to understand my issue and provided clear and reassuring solutions.This level of care and responsiveness truly reflects how much your team values its customers. It’s rare to experience such genuine support these days, and I can confidently say you’ve set the bar very high for customer service.You guys are true customer service legends — thank you for going above and beyond to make sure I felt heard and supported.
Used twice. 1st solar 2nd battery.  Painless install and always great communication.

Having had a great experience with Fritts installing panels and an inverter earlier this year, we didn't hesitate in using them again with a battery installation. Their explanations were helpful in deciding on the system and whether to pursue the WA state rebate, the price was competitive, and the installation very neat. We'd definitely use them again.

We have recently added a 13.8kW BYD Battery arrangement to our new solar panel system which was installed in February 2025. Nothing was too difficult for Fritts and the entire process went smoothly. The tradespeople who undertook the installation were punctual, professional, and left the place neat and tidy, and the system appears to be operating the way it should. We sourced Fritts via "Solar Quotes" and highly recommend the team from Fritts Solar.

When installation day arrived, their Team arrived en masse, removed my inadequate system and installed the upgraded panels and a battery. The Team Lead then spent time explaining the system and the corresponding app. The site was left clean with all rubbish removed.

Fritts Solar was recommended to me by SolarQuotes, and I’m very glad I chose them. From the beginning, Abhi, Darwin, and now Chad gave me prompt and thorough support. Great job and they supplied what we asked for and we changed the plan three times - very understanding.

We approached several companies for quotes and Fritts Solar was the only one that came out to see us. 5kw Fronius Gen24 and 6.6kw Longi Panels. 2 Storey Townhouse.Accommodated my requests to optimise system design for my roof profile (final design we could fit was 3.5kw panels north east, 3.1kw panels north west facing).Fritts provided great quality system at reasonable price, and no fuss, no overselling. Handled all applications and registrations with no extra input needed from me. Installation was done on time and by an excellent team who cleaned up everything. Managed to internally route all cables from one side of property to the other (inverter in garage, switch board on opposite side of house), very tidy install, no conduit running on any external walls.System is meeting household needs on the worst month and weather of the year so will be amazed when it goes in to better sun.  On a cold  rainy June morning, was producing 1.8kw at 7.50am which was more than we are using with the splitsystem ac in the kitchen heating the ground floor.No overselling, just what was needed but I did option up the Consumption meter which is very interesting tool to learn how the house is operating, showing me what I'm importing and exporting from grid, and where the power generated from panels went.Very happy with the Fronius monitoring app and website with great visual displays of an overview how the system is operating in real time.

Chad went above and beyond by taking time out of his busy schedule to help me resolve the problem — all at no additional cost. His support was not only technically effective but also genuinely appreciated during a stressful time. It’s rare to find someone so committed and willing to help, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Thank you, Chad, for your dedication and excellent service!

After I contacted Fritts Solar, they replied promptly and provided options and advice for the package that would be best for my home. Fritts Solar was also the first that offered to visit the site for inspections, though the home was still under construction at the time.The quote provided was he cheapest for the same products - Premium panels and a Fronius Gen 24 inverter system.The scheduling for the installation date was seamless- the team from Fritts Solar liaised with us to arrange a time that was suitable and made some concessions even when Wifi was not yet available at the home. All the while, communications were open and direct.The installation was professionally completed. Support post-install has been awesome - answering questions about the system etc. I have already obtained a quote for a battery package from Fritts and will be installing that early in July (when the rebates kick in).I highly highly recommend Fritts Solar.

Very happy with Fritts solar. The install team were very polite, worked through all issues to get to the best outcome for the customer. Installers worked back to ensure the full system was functioning correctly by days end.

I was looking to upgrade our old 1.5kW system and went to SolarQuotes to do some research. Fritts Solar was one the three recommended installers, and had been the company used by a friend who’d upgraded the year before and had given them the thumbs up. I also had an additional two quotes by other suggested companies. While I have no doubt that at least one of these other companies could deliver, I was immediately impressed with Fritts. The company owner, Abhi, came to my home and explained everything I needed to know to make an informed decision. No glossy brochures or confusing tech specs sheets, just an easy to understand, handwritten summary of the options that he personally recommended. His advice was straight to the point, aimed at a level I could understand, and focussed on what his company could do rather than what other companies couldn’t. Over the following days, Abhi and Jacob responded promptly to all my questions and provided a quote that was very competitive. On installation day the contractors arrived punctually, removed the old system and expertly put in place 14 shiny black 475W Jinko Tiger Neo N-type panels, one Tigo Optimiser, and the handsome Austrian: a Fronius Symo Gen 24 5kW inverter complete with Fronius SmartMeter. I’d already downloaded the Fronius mobile app, so once the guys had everything wired up it was only a matter of minutes before the inverter connected to our network and we could see the new system pumping power to the house and the grid. We have been blessed with a month of almost continuous bright and sunny Autumn days in Perth since installation and the new system has not missed a beat. I am now discussing battery and EV charging options with Abhi and Jacob and am 100% confident that these additions will be managed with the same level of professionalism already demonstrated. I would not hesitate to recommend Fritts to anyone seeking a solar power solution for their home or business.
2 years after installation we had to change our modem. Chad rang back within 24 hours and was very patient in talking us through the challenges to again be online. That's service.
Was very happy with the whole system from the initial quote til the end, following up to make sure all was done in time and working well. Will highly recommend them to anyone.
